import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Compute t-statistics for all features
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(
            feats.x[feats.y==1, col_idx], 
            feats.x[feats.y==0, col_idx]
        )[0]
        t_stats.append((fid, t_stat))
    
    # Sort by absolute t-statistic
    t_stats.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x[1]), reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features (at most MAX_DRIVERS)
    drivers = tuple([fid for fid, _ in t_stats[:MAX_DRIVERS]])
    columns = tuple([fid for fid, _ in t_stats])
    
    # Add some interaction terms
    products = []
    if len(columns) >= 2:
        products = [(columns[0], columns[1])]
    
    # Weighted loading based on t-statistics
    loadings = {fid: t for fid, t in t_stats}
    
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=columns,
        products=products,
        loadings=loadings
    )
